myhf_titles: Stay Active as You Get Older: Quick Tips
Stay Active with a Disability: Quick Tips
medline_titles: How Much Exercise Do I Need?
knowledge_unit_rule: Every complete API section or complete Medline full-summary for these fixed articles, retaining all blocks, headings and article population context; no condition/outcome filter
candidate_rule: All rebuilt units of the query topic, ordered by stable new knowledge ID; no selection using measurements or labels
participant_selection: First three train subject IDs ordered by SHA256(selection_salt, subject_id)
window_selection: One 42-day-history case per participant ordered by SHA256(selection_salt, case_id); no value/quality filtering, no replacement if missing

goals.sleep: I want to understand recent changes in my recorded sleep duration and choose relevant general sleep education. Do not assume insomnia, a particular age, or a personal nightly sleep target.
goals.physical_activity: I want to understand recent changes in my recorded physical activity and choose relevant general activity education. Do not assume a weight-loss goal, a diagnosis, exercise intensity or activity modality.

evidence_arms.B: Topic/Goal plus topic metric mean over 14 days
evidence_arms.C: B plus same metric 14-day mean_difference versus previous 28 days; one acquired probe
evidence_arms.D: B plus unrelated rhr mean over 14 days; one acquired probe, diagnostic negative control
evidence_arms.F: Offline reference only: all 288 legal probes from the same case, no future data

ranker.base_score: Jaccard of lowercase alphabetic query and knowledge tokens, excluding the predeclared stopword set
ranker.source_context_link: 1 only for fixed source locations: sleep MyHF overview and Medline Healthy Sleep; activity MyHF Track Progress and Medline Exercise and Physical Fitness. These are descriptive relevance hypotheses, never hard-condition equivalence or clinical priorities.
ranker.change_context_link: 1 only for Medline Healthy Sleep (discussion of sleep patterns and duration) and MyHF Get Active / Track Progress (tracking recorded steps). These are preregistered ranking hypotheses; source does not assert these ranking weights.
ranker.ties: Equal scores share rank; ID orders serialization only

utility.name: graded judged-slate expected-tie NDCG@5
utility.unknown: Exclude only on a fixed paired reference mask; never grade zero
utility.formal_utility_requires: Independent human reference judgments, including adjudication of disagreements

expected_value_estimation: NOT_ESTIMATED_NO_TRAINING_REFERENCE_GOLD; no test/full-result access in action selection

bootstrap.scope: Exploratory Silver summaries only; three people cannot support population conclusions

feasibility_criteria.engineering: All historical hashes preserved, source reconstruction closes, 12 predeclared contexts retained, no hidden-result/label input to ranker, all accepted references bound and all tests pass
feasibility_criteria.exploratory_personal_signal: At least two contexts across at least two participants have a B-to-C relative grade change explicitly citing the new COMPUTED evidence and an allowed descriptive source link; this is only a candidate signal, not Gold
feasibility_criteria.GO: Engineering gate and independent double-reviewed/adjudicated references cover at least 8 of 12 contexts, with independently supported evidence-dependent relative differences in at least two participants and evaluable nonconstant reference utility
feasibility_criteria.CONDITIONAL_GO: Engineering chain works and legitimate descriptive source-evidence relations exist, but independent human references or source adjudication are missing; exploratory differences may be absent
feasibility_criteria.NO_GO: Unresolved integrity/access violations, zero valid real measurements, or no legitimate descriptive relation between retained knowledge and permitted measurements
